osool-521.title: Syrian-Style Stuffed Zucchini in Yogurt Sauce

instructions.1: Wash the zucchini and hollow them out without peeling, then rinse with salted water.
instructions.2: Stuff with the asag and sauté in half the ghee.
instructions.3: Arrange in the pot, add a little water and cook over low heat, adding a little water from time to time, until tender.
instructions.4: Put the yogurt in a bowl and whisk well; mix the flour well with a little water and add it to the whisked yogurt; beat the egg white lightly and add it to the yogurt; thin the mixture with a little water, then strain through a wire strainer.
instructions.5: Heat the yogurt gently, stirring well, for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Pour it into the pot with the zucchini and heat gently for 5 to 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Chop the garlic finely and fry it in the remaining ghee, then add it to the zucchini, cover the pot and take it off the heat.
instructions.8: Ladle the zucchini onto a plate, pour the sauce over and serve hot.

osool-522-i6.name: Vinegar-garlic sauce or yogurt salad, for serving

instructions.1: Cut the zucchini into medium-thick slices and soak in salted water.
instructions.2: Pat dry, and coat lightly in flour if you like.
instructions.3: Fry in very hot oil.
instructions.4: Arrange on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve with the vinegar-garlic sauce or yogurt sauce.

osool-523.title: Carrots: Boiled, Sautéed or in White Sauce

instructions.1: Wash the carrots and leave whole, or wash, scrape and cut into rounds, sticks or cubes as needed.
instructions.2: Boil in salted water with the pot covered for 20 to 30 minutes; drain, and peel any unpeeled carrots while hot.
instructions.3: Sautéed: put half-boiled carrots in a pan with a cup of water, salt, pepper and the butter and cook over low heat until tender; serve as is, or drain off the liquid and garnish with parsley.
instructions.4: In white sauce: boil the cut carrots, drain and arrange on the plate; cover with the white sauce, garnish with parsley and serve hot.

instructions.1: Prepare the eggplant and cut it into thick rounds or fairly long pieces, and season with salt.
instructions.2: Without an onion base: put the eggplant, meat and tomato and onion rounds raw into a pot in alternating layers with the liquid and seasoning, and cook over low heat or in the oven until tender.
instructions.3: With an onion base: chop the onion and fry in the ghee until golden, then add the meat until browned, then the strained tomatoes and seasoning until the ghee separates; add the liquid and eggplant, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.

osool-525-i6.name: Parsley and tomato rounds, for garnish

instructions.1: Cut the eggplant into fairly thin round slices.
instructions.2: Season with salt and weigh down to press out the liquid, then pat very dry.
instructions.3: Coat lightly in flour, then in egg and breadcrumbs, and fry.
instructions.4: Arrange neatly on a plate and garnish with parsley and tomato rounds.

osool-526.title: Baked Baladi Eggplant Stuffed with Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Peel the eggplants, or leave them unpeeled, or peel them in alternating strips, keeping the stem on in every case.
instructions.2: Slit them along the side, scoop out a little of the flesh and leave them in salted water for a quarter of an hour.
instructions.3: Lift out, pat dry, fry in the ghee and lift out, then stuff with the asag mixed with the pine nuts and parsley.
instructions.4: Arrange side by side in a tray greased with ghee.
instructions.5: Add the water to the tomato juice, season with salt and pepper and pour over the eggplants.
instructions.6: Cover with paper greased with ghee and bake in a moderate oven until done.

osool-527.title: Eggplant Bake with White Sauce and Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Prepare the eggplant as before, season it and drain off its liquid, then sauté in ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Make the white sauce and let it cool somewhat, then add the lightly beaten eggs and stir together.
instructions.3: Layer the eggplant, sauce and asag with pine nuts alternately, making sure the last layer is sauce.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the top with the breadcrumbs, cut the butter into very small pieces and dot them evenly over the top.
instructions.5: Bake in a moderate oven until the top browns.

osool-528.title: Roasted Eggplant with Oil, Lemon and Garlic
osool-528.culturalNotes: Roasted eggplant is also used in tahini dip and baba ghanoush.

osool-528-i4.name: French dressing (oil and vinegar or lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Wash and dry the eggplants, leave them whole and place in a tray.
instructions.2: Roast in a moderate oven until tender.
instructions.3: Peel the roasted eggplants and cut them neatly into long strips.
instructions.4: Crush the garlic finely with some salt and add the chili; season the eggplant with this mixture and arrange on the plate.
instructions.5: Pour the French dressing over and garnish with chopped parsley.

instructions.1: Peel the small potatoes and boil them, or boil them in their skins and then peel.
instructions.2: Heat the butter and toss the potatoes in it; season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with the chopped parsley.
instructions.3: Second method: peel the potatoes and cut into 1 × 1 cm cubes; boil in salted water until nearly done and drain, then sauté in the butter and sprinkle with parsley, salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Third method: cut cold boiled potatoes into even rounds; heat a little ghee until very hot and add the rounds; when the undersides are browned, turn them to brown the other side, then lift onto paper to absorb the ghee and serve hot.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and onions and cut into fairly thick rounds; rub the onions with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Cut the meat into even pieces.
instructions.3: Put the meat, onions and potatoes in a pot in alternating layers.
instructions.4: Pour in the liquid seasoned with salt and pepper and cover the pot.
instructions.5: Cook over low heat until tender, one to one and a half hours.
instructions.6: Serve with the meat in the center and the potatoes around it, hot.
instructions.7: Potato tagine: put the same ingredients in a tagine in alternating layers, finishing with potatoes on top; cover and bake in a moderate oven until done (one to one and a half hours), then uncover so the top browns; wrap the tagine with a paper frill and serve hot.

osool-531.title: Baked Potatoes with Poultry or Meat

osool-531-i3.name: A bird (goose, chicken or small duck) or leg meat

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes, cut into fairly thick rounds and keep in salted water until needed.
instructions.2: Peel the onions, slice into thin rings and rub well with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Strain half the tomatoes; peel the other half and slice into rounds.
instructions.4: Wash the bird or meat and leave whole or cut into fairly large pieces; season with salt and pepper and push half garlic cloves into it if using.
instructions.5: Layer the potatoes and onions alternately in a baking tray or tagine with the meat in the middle and the tomato rounds on top.
instructions.6: Pour over the strained tomatoes and the liquid and put the ghee on top.
instructions.7: Cover and bake in a moderate oven, removing the cover an hour before it is done so the top browns.

instructions.1: Wash and peel the potatoes, cut each into 4 to 8 pieces depending on size, and put in cold salted water.
instructions.2: Pat the potatoes dry and fry them lightly, or leave them unfried.
instructions.3: Make the onion base: fry the onion in the ghee until golden, then add the meat and stir until browned, then the tomatoes and seasoning until the ghee separates; add the liquid and cook over low heat until the meat is half done.
instructions.4: Add the potatoes, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.

instructions.1: Wash the small potatoes and boil until nearly done, then peel while hot.
instructions.2: Heat a little ghee until very hot and fry the potatoes in it.
instructions.3: Lift out, drain of ghee, sprinkle with salt and pepper and serve hot.
instructions.4: Cuts for deep-frying: very thin slices (chips), matchsticks (straws), quarters like orange segments, or a continuous spiral ribbon; soak in cold salted water, then dry and fry in two stages: first in hot ghee until cooked but not browned, then again in hotter ghee until crisp and golden.

instructions.1: Melt the ghee over the heat, add the mashed potatoes and stir well; take off the heat and let cool, then add the egg yolks, salt and pepper and beat well.
instructions.2: Spread the mixture on a plate greased with ghee and leave until cold.
instructions.3: Cut into 8 to 10 pieces and shape like cutlets, inserting a piece of macaroni into the pointed end of each to represent the rib bone.
instructions.4: Coat twice in egg and breadcrumbs, then deep-fry.
instructions.5: Arrange neatly on a plate and serve hot with tomato sauce.

osool-535-i1.name: Small potatoes (for roasting) or large ones (for baking)

osool-535-i4.name: Grated rumi cheese and a little milk or cream (for stuffing)

instructions.1: Roast potatoes: choose small potatoes, wash, peel and put them in cold salted water; either leave raw or parboil them.
instructions.2: Dry well and place in a tray with a little ghee; roast in a fairly hot oven, opening it from time to time to baste the potatoes with the ghee in the tray.
instructions.3: Cook until tender (about an hour if raw, half an hour if parboiled).
instructions.4: Serve with roast meat and poultry.
instructions.5: Baked potatoes: choose large potatoes, wash well and prick lightly with a fork; bake in a hot oven until tender (half an hour to an hour and a half) and serve hot in their skins on a folded napkin with butter.
instructions.6: Cheese-stuffed potatoes: halve the baked potatoes and scoop out the insides with a teaspoon; mash the scooped potato and season with salt, pepper, grated rumi cheese and a little milk or cream; refill the shells, sprinkle the tops with cheese, dot with butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.

osool-536-i1.name: Potatoes, boiled and very finely mashed

instructions.1: Mash the potatoes very thoroughly.
instructions.2: Melt the butter, add the potatoes and stir well over low heat until the mixture comes together.
instructions.3: Take off the heat and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Beat the egg yolks well with a little salt and pepper, then add to the potatoes and stir thoroughly so the yolks are completely blended in.
instructions.5: Put the mixture into a piping bag fitted with a star tip; brush a tray with warm ghee and dust with a little fine rice flour.
instructions.6: Pipe the potato into medium rosettes, and set half a pistachio in the center of each if you like.
instructions.7: Brush the rosettes with lightly beaten egg and bake in a moderate oven for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.8: Serve at once, on their own or with meat dishes.

osool-537.title: Mashed Potato Bake with Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Make a potato purée with the egg yolks, ghee, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Grease the tray with ghee and coat it well with a layer of fine breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Spread half the potato in the tray in a completely even layer.
instructions.4: Spread the asag over this layer and press it down lightly by hand.
instructions.5: Cover the asag with the rest of the potato and smooth the top well.
instructions.6: Brush the top with egg and bake in a moderate oven until golden.
instructions.7: Turn out and serve whole if the tray is small and round, or cut into pieces, arrange on the plate and garnish with parsley.

instructions.1: Wash the spinach several times in cold water, pick off the leaves and boil them in a little salted boiling water with a pinch of baking soda until tender; drain well and chop on a board with a knife.
instructions.2: Put it in a greased ovenproof dish.
instructions.3: Make a white sauce with the butter, flour and milk, add the rumi cheese and season.
instructions.4: Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and dot with the remaining butter cut into small pieces.
instructions.5: Bake in a hot oven until the top browns and serve hot.
instructions.6: Spinach in stock: wash 1 kg spinach and chop coarsely; put in a pot with 1–1½ cups poultry stock, a whole onion, 1 tablespoon butter, salt and pepper and cook until tender.

instructions.1: Boil the spinach, drain it well and mince it in the machine or press through a sieve.
instructions.2: Add 2 tablespoons butter and stir over low heat.
instructions.3: Add the cheese, keeping back 1 tablespoon for the top.
instructions.4: Season with salt and pepper, put into a greased ovenproof dish and sprinkle the top with the grated cheese.
instructions.5: Dot the top with the remaining ½ tablespoon butter cut into very small pieces.
instructions.6: Bake in a hot oven until the top browns.
instructions.7: Spinach with cheese sauce: layer the drained boiled spinach and 1½ cups cheese sauce alternately in a greased dish, finishing with sauce, keeping back half the spinach to decorate the top; sprinkle with cheese, then breadcrumbs, dot with butter and bake in a hot oven until browned; garnish with mounds of boiled spinach and lemon slices.

instructions.1: Prepare and boil the spinach as usual.
instructions.2: Drain and chop finely with a knife or press through a sieve.
instructions.3: Make a thick white sauce with the flour, ghee and ½ cup milk.
instructions.4: Add the sauce to the spinach and boil for 3 minutes.
instructions.5: Season well and add a little milk until it has a medium consistency.
instructions.6: Spoon onto a plate and garnish with the fried bread triangles.

osool-541.title: Stewed Spinach with Dill and Rice

instructions.1: Wash the spinach and dill well, chop coarsely and wash again.
instructions.2: Make the onion base (onion fried in ghee with the meat, then the tomatoes), adding the chickpeas if using.
instructions.3: Add the spinach and dill before adding any liquid and cook over low heat, stirring from time to time.
instructions.4: Add some liquid whenever needed and simmer until nearly done.
instructions.5: Add the washed rice, if using, and cook until tender.
instructions.6: Add the garlic either with the onion base after browning, or raw with the spinach.
instructions.7: With taqliya: fry 1 tablespoon ghee with ½ head chopped garlic and 1 teaspoon ground coriander and add it to the spinach after taking it off the heat.

osool-542.title: Stewed Spinach in an Egg Case

instructions.1: Make the stewed spinach using minced meat.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs lightly and add the salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot in a small pot or mold, coat the sides completely with it, then pour off the excess.
instructions.4: Pour the eggs into the pot and swirl them evenly to coat the bottom and sides.
instructions.5: Drain the spinach of some of its liquid and put it inside the pot.
instructions.6: Set the pot over very low heat or in the oven for 5 to 10 minutes, moving it from time to time so the egg layer browns.
instructions.7: Let it settle briefly, then turn out onto a plate and serve hot.
instructions.8: Spinach mold: wash the spinach, remove just the roots and leave whole; sauté in ghee and lift out; make asag with tomatoes; layer the asag and spinach in a small pot, add water or stock and cook over low heat until done, then turn out onto a plate.
instructions.9: Spinach-stem mold: made like the spinach mold using spinach stems, cut 5 to 6 cm from the root end, cleaned, washed well and soaked in cold salted water for 15 minutes.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs, add the salt, pepper and the rest of the ingredients and mix everything well.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot; pour in a coffee-cup measure of the mixture, and when the underside browns, turn it to brown the other side.
instructions.3: Repeat until the mixture is used up.
instructions.4: Arrange on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve hot with tomato sauce.
instructions.5: Spinach timbales: press 1 kg boiled spinach through a sieve and add 1 tablespoon butter, 2 whole eggs, 3 beaten yolks, salt and pepper; pour into small greased molds, cover with greased paper and steam for 40 minutes, or bake in a tray of water in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes, then turn out.
instructions.6: Large spinach mold: make the same fritter mixture; heat 1 tablespoon ghee until very hot in a mold or small pot and quickly coat the sides; pour in the mixture and bake in a moderate oven for half an hour, then let it settle briefly and turn out.

osool-544-i1.name: Spinach purée (boiled and chopped, in white sauce)

osool-544-i3.name: Boiling water with a little vinegar and salt (for poaching)

instructions.1: Make the spinach purée and put it in a greased ovenproof dish.
instructions.2: Poach the eggs one at a time: break each egg into a cup and slide it into gently simmering water with a little vinegar and salt until the white sets and the yolk stays soft, then lift out with a slotted spoon.
instructions.3: Place the eggs carefully on top of the spinach and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Reheat the dish in a low oven for 5 minutes and serve at once.

instructions.1: Pick the mallow leaves and the chard, wash repeatedly and boil in a little water.
instructions.2: Wash the meat, cut into medium pieces and boil with the onion; shortly before it is done, add the washed rice and cook until tender.
instructions.3: Drain the mallow and chop the dill and fresh coriander, if using; add them to the broth, season with salt and pepper and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Take off the heat; make the taqliya with the garlic, ghee and coriander and add it to the mallow.

instructions.1: Pick the mallow leaves, wash well and dry, then fry in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Fry the onion in the remaining ghee, then add the meat and stir; cover with the broth or water and chickpeas and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the mallow and cook until tender.
instructions.4: Take off the heat; make the taqliya with the coriander, garlic and ghee and add it to the mallow.

osool-547-i9.name: Lemon juice and oil for the beans

instructions.1: Make the sprouted fava bean soup: peel and wash the beans; fry the mastic in the oil, add water and bring to a boil, then add the beans and onion and cook until tender, skimming off the scum.
instructions.2: Prepare the molokhia: wash, pick off the leaves and dry them, then chop finely or mince with a mezzaluna.
instructions.3: Drain the beans, leave them whole and serve them as a salad with some oil and lemon; use the broth to make the molokhia.
instructions.4: Add the molokhia to the boiling broth and stir well until it separates; let it come to the boil twice, uncovered.
instructions.5: Crush the garlic and coriander and fry in the oil, then add this taqliya to the molokhia and cover tightly.

osool-548-i3.name: Coarsely minced meat or poultry pieces

instructions.1: Wash the molokhia, pick off the leaves and dry them well.
instructions.2: Fry the whole molokhia leaves in ghee over medium heat, keeping their green color, then lift out into a colander.
instructions.3: Fry the onion lightly, then add the meat and stir over the heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Wash the chickpeas and add them to the meat along with the stock or water; season with salt and pepper, cover the pot and cook over low heat until nearly done.
instructions.5: Add the fried molokhia and boil for 15 to 20 minutes, then take the pot off the heat.
instructions.6: Make the taqliya and add it to the molokhia.
instructions.7: Crushed borani: prepare and fry the molokhia as above, then crush it well; add to the stew, boil for 10 minutes, then add the taqliya.
instructions.8: Mixed borani: fry half the molokhia and chop it coarsely; chop the other half finely while green; cook the stew and add both kinds, boil for 6 to 10 minutes, then add the taqliya.

instructions.1: Wash the molokhia and pick the leaves, then chop finely with a mezzaluna or by hand.
instructions.2: Clean the fish, cut into steaks and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Heat the oil until very hot and fry the onion until golden, then add the garlic and coriander and stir until the garlic is golden.
instructions.4: Add a liter of water and bring to a boil, then add the fish, lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.5: Lift out the fish and serve it on its own, garnished with parsley; use the broth to make the molokhia.
instructions.6: Add the prepared molokhia to the broth, stirring well, and let it come to the boil twice, uncovered, then take off the heat.

instructions.1: Wash the chard well, pick off the leaves and shred them finely with a knife or mezzaluna.
instructions.2: Make the taqliya with the ghee, garlic and coriander, if using, then add the stock and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the chard and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the dried molokhia, stirring well, let it come to the boil twice, then take off the heat.

osool-551-i1.name: Large loaf of toasted bread, broken up

instructions.1: Add the molokhia to the toasted bread and toss gently; cover and leave until the bread softens.
instructions.2: Layer the fatta and rice alternately, finishing with a layer of rice on top.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot, fry the garlic in it and drizzle over the top; serve hot.

osool-552.title: Green Peppers: Boiled with French Dressing or Fried with Vinegar

osool-552-i3.name: French dressing (oil and vinegar or lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Bring the water to a boil, add the salt and boil the washed peppers, then drain.
instructions.2: Peel off the thin outer skin, keeping the peppers' shape, and remove the stems.
instructions.3: Dress with the French dressing, arrange on a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.
instructions.4: Fried peppers: wash and dry the peppers, slit them slightly on the side and salt them; heat the oil until very hot and fry the peppers, then remove the outer skin and stems; fry the garlic in a little oil, add the vinegar and salt and boil for 3 minutes; arrange the peppers on a plate, dress with the garlic vinegar and serve cold.

instructions.1: Trim the leeks and cut the white part into even pieces.
instructions.2: Wash in cold water, then boil in salted boiling water.
instructions.3: Drain, arrange on a plate and cover with the sauce; garnish with parsley and serve.
instructions.4: Or put them in an ovenproof dish, cover with the sauce, sprinkle the top with a few breadcrumbs, dot with small pieces of butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.

instructions.1: Prepare the leeks, cut the white part and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Sauté the leeks in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.3: Arrange the leeks and the asag with tomatoes in a small pot or ovenproof dish and add the water.
instructions.4: Bake in a low oven or cook over low heat until done.
instructions.5: Stuffed leek mold: drain the boiled leeks, hollow out part of the center of each piece and fill with asag; arrange in a small pot or ovenproof dish, add cold water and cook over low heat or in the oven until done.
instructions.6: Leeks in tomato sauce: half-boil the cut leeks in salted boiling water; make the tomato sauce, add ¼ kg meat and cook until nearly done, then add the leeks and cook until tender.

osool-555.title: Celery Hearts in White or Cheese Sauce

osool-555-i3.name: White sauce or rumi cheese sauce

instructions.1: Trim the celery and cut the white part into even pieces; keep them in cold water with lemon juice until needed.
instructions.2: Boil in boiling water with lemon juice and salt until tender, then drain.
instructions.3: Serve hot with butter, or with buttered toast.
instructions.4: In white sauce: cut the celery lengthwise into medium pieces, arrange on a plate, cover with white sauce and garnish with parsley; or put in an ovenproof dish, cover with the sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake in a hot oven until browned.
instructions.5: In cheese sauce: layer the celery in an ovenproof dish with a little grated cheese between the layers, cover with cheese sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, dot with butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.

instructions.1: Leave the taro whole, wipe it with a damp cloth and bake in a hot oven until tender.
instructions.2: Peel the cooked taro and mash it, then add the butter, milk, salt and pepper and mix well.
instructions.3: Serve with grilled liver and meats, or on its own garnished with fried eggs.

osool-557.title: Taro in Tomato Sauce and Taro Moussaka

instructions.1: Peel the taro and cut into medium-thick slices; do not wash it at all.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, fry the taro in it and lift out.
instructions.3: Cut the meat into small pieces, wash, then brown it in the ghee left from frying the taro.
instructions.4: Add the strained tomatoes and cook until done, then add the vinegar, then the taro, and stir briefly.
instructions.5: Add enough water to cover the taro, season with salt and pepper and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.6: Taro moussaka: peel the taro, cut each lengthwise into quarters and then into ½ cm thick pieces, and fry lightly; layer alternately with an onion base made with minced meat in a pot or tagine, pour over the liquid and cook until tender.

osool-558.title: Purslane: Boiled, with Oil and Lemon, or Stewed

osool-558-i3.name: French dressing (oil, lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Wash the purslane several times in cold water and pick off the leaves.
instructions.2: Boiled: boil in a little salted boiling water until tender and drain.
instructions.3: With oil and lemon: let the boiled purslane cool, chop it coarsely and add the French dressing just before serving.
instructions.4: In stock: put the coarsely chopped purslane in a pot with 1–1½ cups stock, a whole onion, 1 tablespoon butter, salt and pepper and cook until tender.
instructions.5: Stewed: make the onion base with the meat and tomatoes in the ghee, add the chopped purslane before adding any liquid and stir over low heat; add liquid as needed until nearly done, then add the rice or chickpeas and cook until tender (without dill).

osool-559.title: Okra with Chard and Garlic Paste (Khodra)

instructions.1: Wash the okra and let it dry, then trim the tops into a cone shape.
instructions.2: Half-boil the meat with the onion, skimming off the scum whenever it appears, then add the okra and cook until tender.
instructions.3: Prepare the chard: wash, remove the ribs and shred; peel the garlic and chop it finely.
instructions.4: Fry the chard briefly in the ghee, then add the garlic and stir until golden; then mash the chard very thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.5: Add the green paste to the okra and boil for 5 minutes.

instructions.1: Prepare the okra, fry it lightly in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Make the onion base in the remaining ghee: brown the onion, then add the meat, then the strained tomatoes and seasoning until the ghee separates.
instructions.3: Lift the meat out of the sauce and put a layer of it in the bottom of a small pot; arrange the okra neatly on top, then put the rest of the meat in the center.
instructions.4: Fill the pot with the okra, add the onion base and close the lid tightly.
instructions.5: Cook over low heat until done, and turn out onto a plate when ready to serve.
instructions.6: Okra mold with minced meat: made as above, but with the onion base made with minced meat instead of cubes.
instructions.7: Okra mold, third method: clean the okra, fry lightly and lift out; sauté the chopped onion briefly in the remaining ghee, add the cubed meat and stir, then add a little water and cook for 15 minutes; lift out the meat and arrange it in the bottom of the pot with a layer of onion, then arrange the okra, add the tomato juice and the rest of the water and cook over low heat; a sliced carrot can be added with the meat.
